explanation: Mathlib has `Real.hasDerivAt_sqrt` and `HasDerivAt.sqrt` in `Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Sqrt.lean`, plus the generic `HasDerivAt.inv` rule, but I found no declaration for the derivative of the inverse square-root composition itself. Combining the square-root derivative with the inverse derivative would require two distinct derivative results, so it does not qualify as a one-declaration match.
